compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story

As a developer, `docs/orphan-task-convention.md` documents the DEFER ticket pattern (when to create orphan tasks, required tags, lifecycle rules) and CLAUDE.md is updated with a one-line pointer, so that future epics adopt consistent orphan-task handling without re-inventing the pattern.

## Done Definitions

- [ ] `docs/orphan-task-convention.md` exists and documents: (a) definition of orphan task, (b) required tag `orphan:deferred_review`, (c) when the orchestrator creates them (DEFER ruling), (d) lifecycle: how they get picked up in future sprints, (e) validate-issues.sh exemption behavior
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` gains exactly one line in the Architecture (pointers) section: `- **Orphan-task convention** (DEFER rulings, lifecycle, validate-issues.sh exemption): \`docs/orphan-task-convention.md\`` — no inline expansion
- [ ] An interim consumer plan is included in the convention doc: how existing callers that produce orphan tasks (if any) should migrate to the new tagging scheme; list known consumers from a grep
- [ ] The doc passes the CLAUDE.md bloat criteria: it contains no architectural implementation details that belong in SKILL.md, no duplicate rules, and no onboarding-only content

## Considerations

- [Ordering] Must run after S5, which implements the DEFER ticket creation behavior that this doc describes
- [CLAUDE.md rule 2b] Do NOT add more than one line to CLAUDE.md; if more context is needed, it belongs in the convention doc itself
- [CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE] Emit a `CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE:` report with the exact one-line addition so the orchestrator can apply it without ambiguity
- [Escalation policy] Escalate when blocked
